So every slot installed by a build in 2364d4e3..8daa6b07^ carries a 6-key /1 manifest {databaseDigest, generationDigest, incarnationRef, keyEpochRef, payloadDigests, slotManifestVersion:"moe-recovery-slot/1"}. At HEAD recovery-slot-manifest.ts V1_KEYS has 5 keys (:11-17), exactDataRecord demands the exact key count (:95), readLegacy returns null for the 6-key shape (:162-170), decode answers REFUSED, and verifySlot maps it to RECOVERY_ANCHOR_PERSISTENCE_UNPROVEN (install.ts:160). recovery-anchor-refusals.test.ts:503 pins that refusal on purpose (task-33d2c0d9 DoD[2]); task-228085fc DoD[0] scoped /1 compatibility to fixtures without databaseDigest. The reviewer's measurement outranks both: the shape was genuinely emitted, so refusing it strands every anchor installed in that window.

SHARED FILES / BUILD ORDER (safety, not paperwork): recovery-anchor-install.ts and recovery-anchor-refusals.test.ts are being edited by task-55c57abc; landing this row first would force a hand rebase of both and could drop half (A)'s try boundary. Verify-or-block on (A)'s commit being an ancestor of HEAD.

Keep recovery-slot-manifest.ts (242 lines) under 250 by extracting the key-set/dispatch helpers into a sibling module with a .js bridge if needed.
